events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Brightwater Dental, this is Marcus, uh, can you hold one sec? Okay. Sorry. How can I help?

events.speaker: user
events.text: Hi Marcus, it's Claire Donovan from The Herakles, a digital studio. Quick note first, I use an assistant that analyses this call, just so you know.

events.speaker: user
events.text: Thanks. So, I work with dental practices on how they look to new patients. Who usually handles that kind of thing at Brightwater?

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: That'd be Dr. Alvarez, but honestly, I've got a waiting room full and two phones ringing, so this, uh, this really isn't a great minute.

events.speaker: user
events.text: Totally fair. One question and I'll let you go. When patients find you online, does the practice look the way it feels inside?

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Ha. No. No, not really. The logo's, um, from like twenty ten. And the sign outside doesn't match the cards.

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: And we just renovated, so it's kind of, it's kind of weird now.

events.speaker: user
events.text: That's really common after a renovation. What we do is a brand identity refresh. Logo, colours, signage, the forms patients fill in. So everything finally matches the new space.

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Yeah, but, uh, we kind of blew the budget on the chairs and the flooring. I don't think there's money left for, you know, design stuff.

events.speaker: user
events.text: Makes sense. We often phase it, starting small, just the logo and the sign, and spread the rest over the year. Would that change things?

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Huh. Maybe. Look, can you just email me something? I'll, uh, I'll pass it on to her.

events.speaker: user
events.text: Happy to. Though emails tend to sink. What if I show Dr. Alvarez three before-and-after examples from other practices, fifteen minutes, on a day that's quiet for you?

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Oh, before and after, she'd love that. Thursdays, she's free at twelve thirty. Thursday works?

events.speaker: user
events.text: Thursday at twelve thirty is perfect.

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Great, I'm putting it in her calendar right now. Honestly, I've been nagging her about that sign for months.

events.speaker: user
events.text: Then we're on the same side. I'll send a short invite so it doesn't get lost. Thanks, Marcus.

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Perfect, thanks Claire. Gotta run, bye!
